111	class RestrictedUnpickler(pickle.Unpickler):
112	    """A restricted unpickler that only allows whitelisted classes.
113	
114	    This prevents arbitrary code execution during deserialization by
115	    blocking dangerous modules such as os, subprocess, builtins.eval,
116	    builtins.exec, etc.
117	
118	    Usage:
119	        with open('model.pdparams', 'rb') as f:
120	            data = RestrictedUnpickler(f).load()
121	    """
122	
123	    def find_class(self, module: str, name: str) -> type:
124	        """Override find_class to restrict which classes can be loaded.
125	
126	        Args:
127	            module: The module name containing the class.
128	            name: The class name to load.
129	
130	        Returns:
131	            The class object if it is in the whitelist.
132	
133	        Raises:
134	            pickle.UnpicklingError: If the class is not in the whitelist.
135	        """
136	        allowed_names = _ALLOWED_CLASSES.get(module)
137	        if allowed_names is not None:
138	            if '*' in allowed_names or name in allowed_names:
139	                return super().find_class(module, name)
140	
141	        raise pickle.UnpicklingError(
142	            f"Forbidden class: {module}.{name}. "
143	            f"For security, only whitelisted classes are allowed during "
144	            f"deserialization of model files. If you believe this class "
145	            f"should be allowed, please report an issue at "
146	            f"https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/Paddle/issues"
147	        )
148	
149	
150	def safe_load_pickle(f, encoding='latin1'):
151	    """Safely load a pickle file using RestrictedUnpickler.
152	
153	    Args:
154	        f: A file-like object (opened in binary mode) to read from.
155	        encoding: The encoding to use for unpickling (default: 'latin1').
156	
157	    Returns:
158	        The deserialized Python object.
159	
160	    Raises:
161	        pickle.UnpicklingError: If the pickle data contains forbidden classes.
162	    """
163	    return RestrictedUnpickler(f, encoding=encoding).load()
164	
165	
166	def safe_loads_pickle(data, encoding='latin1'):
167	    """Safely load pickle data from bytes using RestrictedUnpickler.
168

171	        encoding: The encoding to use for unpickling (default: 'latin1').
172

175

177	        pickle.UnpicklingError: If the pickle data contains forbidden classes.
178	    """
179	    import io
180	
181	    return RestrictedUnpickler(io.BytesIO(data), encoding=encoding).load()
